references.text: Moses was on the mountain for forty days and forty nights, as mentioned here in Deuteronomy 10:10
Moses was with the Lord for forty days and forty nights without eating bread or drinking water, when he received the tablets of the law again
Moses describes his first period of forty days and forty nights on the mountain, which parallels this second period
Moses threw himself down before the face of the Lord for forty days and forty nights and prayed for the people
The Lord changed His mind and would not destroy the people, as it is referred to that the Lord did not want to destroy them
The Lord listened to Moses and would not destroy the people, parallel to how the Lord also listened to Moses this time
